findings.evidence: The theorem at lines 45–48 assumes only squarefreeness and rational nonsquareness. Roadmap `Multiquadratic/README.md:125-131` explicitly warns that for real fields the ordinary 2-rank can drop (e.g. `ℚ(√3)`) and `t−1` requires the narrow class group.
findings.fix: Qualify the claimed ordinary-class-group connection to imaginary quadratic fields, or refer to the narrow class group/genus field for real fields; also state that identifying the candidate with the relevant genus field remains future work.
findings.issue: Lines 21 and 44 call this the group-order side/shadow of `Gal(K_gen/ℚ(√d)) ≅ Cl/Cl²`, but the theorem allows real `d`, where the uniform `2^(t-1)` formula concerns the narrow class group and can disagree with ordinary `Cl/Cl²`.

summary: The documentation incorrectly presents the uniform relative-cardinality theorem as matching an ordinary class-group quotient for real as well as imaginary quadratic fields.
